010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Agent;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Task;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Team;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Tool;

021import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.RunTeamRequest;

039/**
040 * End-to-end Select AI Agent workflow sample.
041 *
042 * <p>The sample creates a SQL tool, task, agent, and team in that order. It
043 * then creates a database conversation, runs the team, and sends a second
044 * prompt using the same conversation ID. Finally, it drops the resources it
045 * created in reverse dependency order. Every cleanup is attempted even when
046 * another cleanup fails. Execution and cleanup failures propagate to the
047 * command-line caller, producing a nonzero exit status; cleanup errors are
048 * suppressed on an existing execution failure.</p>
049 *
050 * <p>The profile named by {@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME} must already exist and
051 * be accessible to the configured database user. The sample creates persistent
052 * database resources while it runs and removes them during cleanup.</p>
053 *
054 * <p>This sample demonstrates conversation continuation, not a guaranteed
055 * human-input pause. For a workflow that verifies {@code WAITING_FOR_HUMAN}
056 * and resumes through a new connection pool, see {@link PooledTeamResumeSample}.</p>
057 *
058 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
059 * <ul>
060 *   <li>{@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}</li>
061 *   <li>{@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD}</li>
062 *   <li>{@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}</li>
063 *   <li>{@code SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME}</li>
064 * </ul>
065 *
066 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
067 * <ul>
068 *   <li>{@code SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_PREFIX} - prefix for generated resource
069 *       names; a unique prefix is generated when omitted.</li>
070 *   <li>{@code SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_TOOL_NAME}</li>
071 *   <li>{@code SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_TASK_NAME}</li>
072 *   <li>{@code SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_AGENT_NAME}</li>
073 *   <li>{@code SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_TEAM_NAME}</li>
074 *   <li>{@code SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_FIRST_PROMPT} - defaults to
075 *       {@code What is 2 + 2?}.</li>
076 *   <li>{@code SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_CONTINUATION_PROMPT} - defaults to
077 *       {@code Explain that result in one sentence.}.</li>
078 * </ul>
079 *
080 * <p>Build and run from the repository root:</p>
081 * <pre>{@code
082 * mvn clean install
083 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime \
084 *     -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
085 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.1.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
086 *     -d samples/out \
087 *     samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/AgentWorkflowSample.java
088 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.1.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
089 *     com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent.AgentWorkflowSample
090 * }</pre>
091 *
092 * @see CreateToolSample
093 * @see CreateTaskSample
094 * @see CreateAgentSample
095 * @see CreateTeamSample
096 * @see RunTeamSample
097 * @see com.oracle.database.selectai.Conversation#create()
098 */
099public final class AgentWorkflowSample {
100    private AgentWorkflowSample() {
101    }
102
103    /**
104     * Creates the resources, runs the team twice, and removes the resources.
105     *
106     * @param args command-line arguments; not used
107     * @throws SelectAIException when execution, resource cleanup, or client closure fails
108     */
109    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
110        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
111        String prefix = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_PREFIX", generatedPrefix());
112        String toolName = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_TOOL_NAME", prefix + "_TOL");
113        String taskName = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_TASK_NAME", prefix + "_TSK");
114        String agentName = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_AGENT_NAME", prefix + "_AGT");
115        String teamName = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_TEAM_NAME", prefix + "_TEM");
116
117        try (SelectAIAgent agentClient = createAgentClient();
118             SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI()) {
119            run(agentClient, selectAI, profileName, toolName, taskName, agentName, teamName,
120                    envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_FIRST_PROMPT", "What is 2 + 2?"),
121                    envOrDefault("SELECTAI_AGENT_WORKFLOW_CONTINUATION_PROMPT",
122                            "Explain that result in one sentence."));
123        }
124    }
125
126    /** Runs with caller-owned clients; only resources created here are cleaned up. */
127    static void run(SelectAIAgent agentClient, SelectAI selectAI, String profileName,
128                   String toolName, String taskName, String agentName, String teamName,
129                   String firstPrompt, String continuationPrompt) throws SelectAIException {
130        try (Cleanup cleanup = new Cleanup()) {
131            Tool tool = agentClient.tool(toolName,
132                    ToolAttributes.builder()
133                            .toolType(ToolType.SQL)
134                            .toolParams(SqlToolParams.builder().profileName(profileName).build())
135                            .build(),
136                    "SQL tool created by AgentWorkflowSample.",
137                    ToolStatus.ENABLED);
138            if (tool.create()) {
139                cleanup.add("tool", toolName, () -> tool.drop(false));
140            }
141
142            Task task = agentClient.task(taskName,
143                    TaskAttributes.builder()
144                            .instruction("Answer the user's question using the SQL tool: {query}")
145                            .tools(List.of(toolName))
146                            .build(),
147                    "Task created by AgentWorkflowSample.",
148                    TaskStatus.ENABLED);
149            if (task.create()) {
150                cleanup.add("task", taskName, () -> task.drop(false));
151            }
152
153            Agent agent = agentClient.agent(agentName,
154                    AgentAttributes.builder()
155                            .profileName(profileName)
156                            .role("Answer the user's question clearly and accurately.")
157                            .tools(List.of(toolName))
158                            .build(),
159                    "Agent created by AgentWorkflowSample.",
160                    AgentStatus.ENABLED);
161            if (agent.create()) {
162                cleanup.add("agent", agentName, () -> agent.drop(false));
163            }
164
165            Team team = agentClient.team(teamName,
166                    TeamAttributes.builder()
167                            .agents(List.of(TeamMember.builder(agentName).task(taskName).build()))
168                            .process("sequential")
169                            .build(),
170                    "Team created by AgentWorkflowSample.",
171                    TeamStatus.ENABLED);
172            if (team.create()) {
173                cleanup.add("team", teamName, () -> team.drop(false));
174            }
175
176            Conversation conversation = selectAI.conversation(ConversationAttributes.builder()
177                    .title("AgentWorkflowSample conversation")
178                    .build());
179            String conversationId = conversation.create();
180            cleanup.add("conversation", conversationId, () -> conversation.drop(false));
181
182            RunTeamRequest.Builder request = RunTeamRequest.builder()
183                    .userPrompt(firstPrompt)
184                    .conversationId(conversationId);
185            TeamRunResult firstResult = team.run(request.build());
186            System.out.printf("First team response: %s%n", firstResult.getRawValue());
187
188            // Reuse the builder and conversation without changing the first request.
189            TeamRunResult continuationResult = team.run(request.userPrompt(continuationPrompt).build());
190            System.out.printf("Continued team response: %s%n", continuationResult.getRawValue());
191        }
192        System.out.println("Workflow cleanup completed.");
193    }
194
195    private static SelectAIAgent createAgentClient() throws SelectAIException {
196        return SelectAIAgent.create(connectionConfig());
197    }
198
199    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
200        return SelectAI.create(connectionConfig());
201    }
202
203    private static DbConnectionConfig connectionConfig() {
204        return DbConnectionConfig.builder()
205                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
206                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
207                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
208                .build();
209    }
210
211    /** Aggregates cleanup failures while preserving try-with-resources suppression. */
212    private static final class Cleanup implements AutoCloseable {
213        /** Successfully created resources, most recent first. */
214        private final Deque<CleanupAction> actions = new ArrayDeque<>();
215
216        private void add(String resourceType, String name, DropOperation operation) {
217            actions.push(new CleanupAction(resourceType, name, operation));
218        }
219
220        @Override
221        public void close() throws SelectAIException {
222            SelectAIException failure = null;
223            while (!actions.isEmpty()) {
224                CleanupAction action = actions.pop();
225                try {
226                    action.operation().drop();
227                } catch (Exception e) {
228                    SelectAIException cleanupFailure = new SelectAIException(
229                            "Failed to drop " + action.resourceType() + " '" + action.name()
230                                    + "' created by AgentWorkflowSample", e);
231                    if (failure == null) {
232                        failure = cleanupFailure;
233                    } else {
234                        failure.addSuppressed(cleanupFailure);
235                    }
236                }
237            }
238            if (failure != null) {
239                throw failure;
240            }
241        }
242    }
243
244    /** One resource owned by this sample. */
245    private record CleanupAction(String resourceType, String name, DropOperation operation) { }
246
247    /** Drop operation registered only after successful creation. */
248    @FunctionalInterface
249    private interface DropOperation {
250        void drop() throws SelectAIException;
251    }
252
253    private static String generatedPrefix() {
254        return "JSAIWF_" + UUID.randomUUID().toString()
255                .replace("-", "")
256                .substring(0, 8)
257                .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
258    }
259
260    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
261        String value = System.getenv(name);
262        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
263            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
264        }
265        return value;
266    }
267
268    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
269        String value = System.getenv(name);
270        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
271    }
272}
